settings.title: Settings
settings.cacheCoverDescription: Book covers are downloaded from Google Books and Open Library and stored in a local cache for better performance. You can clear the cache to reload all covers.
settings.cacheInfo: After clearing the cache, covers will be reloaded on the next library refresh.
settings.deviceCollectionsDescription: Before every change to metadata.calibre the app keeps a copy on the Kindle itself (the .kindle-organizer folder, last 10 copies). If the collections on the device look wrong, you can go back to one of these copies.
settings.backupsError: Could not read the Kindle's backups
settings.restoreConfirm: Replace metadata.calibre on the Kindle with the backup from {{date}}? The current file is saved as a backup too, so you can go back.
settings.restoreNeedsKindle: Connect a Kindle to restore a backup.
settings.diagnosticsDescription: The app's errors and warnings are saved to a log file (main.log). Attach it when you report a problem.
settings.openLogsError: Could not open the logs folder
settings.libraryFoldersDescription: Books in these folders appear in the library without being copied, and the app follows changes while it is open. The files are never changed or deleted.
settings.removeLibraryFolderConfirm: Unlink “{{path}}”? Its books leave the library, but the files stay in the folder.

about.title: About
about.description: Manage and organize your Kindle library with ease
about.descriptionLong: Kindle Organizer is a desktop tool that allows you to organize your Kindle books into collections, manage covers, and sync data with your device.
about.feature1: Collection Management - Create, modify, and delete collections to organize your books
about.feature2: Cover Download - Automatically from Google Books and Open Library
about.feature3: Collections on the Kindle (experimental) - With the jb.sh jailbreak, the Kindle applies the app's collections when you unplug it
about.feature4: Multi-language Support - Available in Italian and English
about.feature5: Local Cache - Superior speed with intelligent caching

dialog.title: First collection sync
dialog.intro: From now on, every time you unplug the Kindle its collections will become equal to the app's top-level collections: sub-collections are merged into the collection that contains them.
dialog.kindleHas: The Kindle already has these collections:
dialog.unreadable: Could not read the Kindle's collections, so they cannot be imported. Unplug the Kindle, let it finish, then connect it again.
dialog.importHint: They become app collections with their books, and the Kindle keeps them up to date.
dialog.confirmDiscard: Confirm: delete them at the next unplug
dialog.discardHint: When you unplug the Kindle, it will keep only the app's collections.
